findings.reason: The diff deletes the `if (opts.flowSkipColonSpace) opts.quoteFlowKeys = true` guard. presenter.ts:215 still sets sep='' and :223 emits `${keyText}:${valueText}` with an unquoted key. parser.ts:807-809 ends a plain scalar at ':' only when whitespace or a flow indicator follows, so `a:1` is read as one scalar. C3 describes the same removed safeguard (the docs/migrate_v4_to_v5.md:184 mapping makes it more likely users hit it), so it is merged here. Kept at critical because this is silent data corruption.
findings.claim: Removing the forced quoteFlowKeys when flowSkipColonSpace is on makes dump write `{a:1}`, which the parser loads back as {'a:1': null}, so data silently changes on round-trip.
findings.evidence: The diff deletes `if (opts.flowSkipColonSpace) { opts.quoteFlowKeys = true }` from createPresenterState and deletes the doc note that this "forces `quoteFlowKeys`; otherwise `a:1` would be parsed as a single plain scalar instead of a mapping entry." writeFlowMapping (line 215) now sets `sep = ''` and joins `${keyText}:${valueText}` around an unquoted key. In src/parser/parser.ts:807-809 a plain scalar ends at `:` only when the next character is whitespace or a flow indicator (`if (isWsOrEolOrEnd(following) || (inFlow && isFlowIndicator(following))) break`), so in `{a:1}` the `:1` stays part of the scalar `a:1`.

findings.reason: Confirmed that dump-options.test.mjs:154 asserts '{a:1}\n' without calling load, and dump-fuzzy.test.mjs:36 is `it.skip`. But this test file is not in the diff, so the coverage gap is pre-existing rather than introduced by the change. Lowered from medium to low; the real defect is tracked in the merged C1/X1/C3 item.
findings.claim: The flowSkipColonSpace test only checks the printed string, never loads it back, and the round-trip fuzz test is skipped, so nothing catches the regression.
findings.evidence: `assert.equal(dump({ a: 1 }, { flowLevel: 0, flowSkipColonSpace: true }), '{a:1}\n')` has no `load(output)` check. The neighbouring quoteFlowKeys test does check with `assert.deepEqual(load(output), { [key]: 1 })`. The round-trip property test in test/core/dump-fuzzy.test.mjs:36 covers `flowSkipColonSpace` but is disabled with `it.skip`, so nothing catches the regression.
